notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirit token(s) enter, Railway Brawler triggers that many times, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token.
When the Carnivore token enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on the Carnivore token.
Repeat.

uses.name: One with the Kami
uses.cardState: attached to any creature you control
